sources.title: Model Card for Cohere Labs Command R7B
sources.evidence: Exact dated checkpoint card: open-weight research release, nominal 7B size, CC-BY-NC terms, text input/output, 128K context, chat, RAG generation and native conversational tool use. Describes autoregressive Transformer with repeating local RoPE/global NoPE attention. Reopened October 27, 2026: the original card still states nominal 7B, while the Hub display shows 8B. It does not identify the 7B label as an active count.

sources.title: Announcing Command R7b — December 13, 2024
sources.evidence: Dated release announcement explicitly identifies command-r7b-12-2024, says it is available that day on Cohere and Hugging Face, and places it in the R family.

sources.title: Introducing Command R7B: Fast and efficient generative AI
sources.evidence: Launch title and December 13, 2024 publication date corroborate the release note. The fetched page omitted the article body; no body claims were inferred.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint public metadata
sources.evidence: Revision 4f3d0aa6856e322f2f4480fe65420d5d53d297b8 reports safetensors.parameters.BF16 and total of 8,028,033,024; Cohere2ForCausalLM; cohere2; cc-by-nc-4.0; gated=auto. Templates include tool_plan and function calls. This is a hosted parameter aggregate, not an independently recounted tensor inventory. Fresh October 27 metadata returns the same revision and 8,028,033,024 BF16 aggregate.

sources.title: Cohere2ForCausalLM implementation, Transformers v4.55.0
sources.evidence: Cohere2ForCausalLM instantiates Cohere2Model and every decoder layer instantiates Cohere2MLP with dense gate/up/down projections, without expert routing. It includes token embeddings and an LM head. RoPE inv_freq is a nonpersistent buffer; LayerNorm weight is a learned parameter. No quantization-scale storage is defined in this implementation.

sources.title: Cohere's Command R7B Model
sources.evidence: Exact API ID command-r7b-12-2024 has a 128,000-token context, text-generation chat endpoints, and documented RAG, tool-use and multistep-agent applications.

sources.title: Command R7B ModelShowcase source
sources.evidence: Exact command-r7b-12-2024 capabilities enable ToolUse, Multilingual, SafetyModes, Citations and StructuredOutputs. Reasoning and ImageInputs are absent from the enabled capabilities.

sources.title: ModelShowcase capability renderer
sources.evidence: getCapabilities marks Reasoning and ImageInputs disabled when not in enabledCapabilities; disabled icons receive a strike-through. Flattened HTML lists both enabled and disabled labels, so the plain label list alone is misleading.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: License linked from the checkpoint identifies Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International with an Acceptable Use Addendum.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model (April 14, 2025 revision)
sources.evidence: First-party later report explicitly includes Command R7B and discusses shared architectural ideas and model merging. Its merging is weight combination into one model, not inference-time expert routing. No separately labeled total/active parameter pair for R7B was located. Independently inspected the full report freshly fetched October 27, including all R7B references and active/activated terminology; no separate count convention is supplied.

sources.title: Rope to Nope and Back Again: A New Hybrid Attention Strategy (October 22, 2025 revision)
sources.evidence: Later first-party architecture research reports 8B including token embeddings for its experimental models, but does not name Command R7B. Its experimental dimensions/count are therefore not transferred to this exact release. Reopened October 27 section 2.1 and Table 1: 8 billion explicitly includes token embeddings, but this still describes experimental variants without an exact R7B mapping.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration — gated
sources.evidence: HTTP 401 prevented inspecting exact configuration dimensions and tie settings. Public repository metadata remained accessible.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tensor index — gated
sources.evidence: HTTP 401 prevented independent tensor enumeration and parameter recount. No full weight shard was downloaded.

sources.title: Aya Vision: Advancing the Frontier of Multilingual Multimodality, section 4.1 and Table 6
sources.evidence: Section 4.1 explicitly links command-r7b-12-2024 as the backbone subsequently post-trained for Aya Vision 8B. Table 6 labels its LLM component 8B, separately from a 400M vision encoder and 190M connector. This is later corroboration for an approximately 8B language backbone, not a direct exact recount of the original checkpoint. Independently inspected the fresh October 27 full report, section 4.1 and Table 6; no active-count column or convention is given.

sources.title: Command R7B Arabic model card — parameter scope clarification
sources.evidence: The related Arabic model explicitly reports approximately 8B total as 7B Transformer plus 1B embedding parameters. This explains the naming convention but is not by itself evidence that every fine-tune preserves the original count. Reopened October 27: the explicit approximately 8B = 7B Transformer + 1B embedding statement remains.

sources.title: Arabic checkpoint metadata used only to corroborate parameter scope
sources.evidence: Revision 2d5440c7cea22410006fb461a1b24c067683da77 reports the same BF16 aggregate, 8,028,033,024, as the exact December base checkpoint. This supports the interpretation of the base model nominal 7B label as excluding approximately 1B embeddings.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete later report freshly fetched October 27 for R7B references, parameter definitions and active/activated terminology. Table 2 separates Tiny Aya embedding, non-embedding and total counts; these are not an active-count convention for R7B.

sources.title: Command R7B Arabic: A Small, Enterprise Focused, Multilingual, and Culturally Aware Arabic LLM
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete report freshly fetched October 27. Section 3.1 explicitly starts from Command R7B, followed by SFT, preference tuning and parameter-wise model merging. This confirms the named-base relationship; no separate active count is supplied.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Its 218B total and 25B active figures describe Command A+, and the comparison table lists Command A variants. It supplies neither a Command R7B active count nor a general rule equating dense totals and active counts.

sources.title: How small AI models can make a big impact for enterprises
sources.evidence: Fresh search found this September 2, 2026 first-party article, read October 27. It repeats R7B nominal 7B and Tiny Aya 3.35B sizes; only North Mini Code is explicitly distinguished as 30B total and 3B active. It does not relabel R7B 7B as active or resolve its embedding scope.

sources.title: Command R7B directory entry
sources.evidence: Fresh direct October 27 retrieval succeeded after the web reader failed. It lists 7B total and 7B active, but its sole Official source link is the generic Cohere models overview, with no field-specific derivation. That primary page does not establish an active count. Recorded as an uncorroborated lead, not accepted as developer evidence.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere Models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 to check the source cited by the third-party active-count claim. The exact R7B row states context, modality and supported endpoint information but gives no active count or dense activation convention.

name.note: Official display name; the exact dated API identity is command-r7b-12-2024.

developer.note: Developer and research lab are explicitly credited.

family.note: Normalized catalog family key for the official R family.

release_date.note: Explicit first-party public release date; repository creation on December 11 is not treated as release.

open_weights.note: Weights are released subject to automatic access gating and noncommercial terms.

license.note: Includes Cohere acceptable-use addendum; this is not an unrestricted commercial license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 checks retain approximately 8B complete parameters including embeddings. The exact base metadata remains 8.028033024B; Aya Vision identifies this exact backbone and gives its language component as 8B; the Arabic card separates 7B Transformer plus 1B embeddings and its report explicitly identifies R7B as the starting checkpoint. Together these support the labeled cross-source scope inference. The original card and newer small-model blog retain the nominal 7B branding without resolving scope. No repeat tensor census is required for this approximate total.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model active/activated and lineage searches, reopened original evidence and later first-party reports/comparisons found no separately defined active count. The 7B Transformer portion is not automatically an active count; 8B total is not copied for a dense model. The appz 7B-active claim cites a generic overview that supplies no count convention. North Mini Code and Command A+ active counts concern different models.

architecture.note: Autoregressive decoder Transformer with dense MLPs in Cohere2ForCausalLM. Local/global attention is a repeating pattern, not four total layers; training-time expert merging does not imply MoE routing.

context_window.note: Exact API documentation specifies 128,000 tokens; do not replace it with a generic configuration default.

modalities.note: Checkpoint card explicitly states text-only input and output; exact capability display disables image input.

reasoning.note: Dedicated native Reasoning capability is disabled by the exact model page and renderer. Tool planning and general problem-solving claims do not establish that distinct capability; the template ties its thinking spans to tool-use turns.

tool_call.note: Native function-call schemas, tool-call output, tool_plan and tool-result turns are documented and enabled.

description.value: Cohere multilingual text-generation model for long-context chat, retrieval-augmented generation, and multistep tool use.
description.note: Replaces ambiguous retrieval-model wording with its generation role and directly documented capabilities.

patch.description: Cohere multilingual text-generation model for long-context chat, retrieval-augmented generation, and multistep tool use.
patch.notes: Approximately 8B including embeddings. The 7B Transformer plus 1B embedding interpretation is inferred from exact checkpoint metadata and later Cohere backbone/component disclosures. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. Weights use CC-BY-NC-4.0 with an acceptable-use addendum. The reasoning flag denotes a dedicated reasoning capability; tool planning is supported.

Aya Vision report: exact backbone and LLM component size
Cohere Arabic card: parameter scope corroboration

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained approximately 8B complete parameters, with the 7B naming scope explicitly reconciled from original metadata and later first-party backbone/component evidence. Fresh exact-model searches, reopened cards and later reports/comparisons found no supported active count. Recorded the unsupported third-party 7B-active lead; added explicit parameter patches, shortened public notes and preserved unrelated assessments. No weight shards or repeat census requested.
